budgets.note: Regenerated 2026-09-01 for Slice 6. Same 292/146/60 geometry as the 2026-08-26 build; the change is the rig, which now carries all FIVE clips the skeleton contract names (idle, move, attack, hit, death) instead of idle alone. lod1/lod2/collision came out byte-identical to the previous build, so only the rigged lod0 hash moved.

similarityReviewed.note: a 6-voxel blockout on a 3-bone rig; every clip is a procedural bone-rotation curve (sway, waddle, lunge, flinch, topple) written as numbers in swan_pipe_stages.py - no motion capture, no reference footage, no likeness to anything.

clipContract.note: Presence of a named clip proves nothing - a clip can be named and empty and pass every other check. These are the properties that matter: clips that repeat or recover must return to their start pose or they snap; death must NOT, or the corpse stands back up.
